category.name: IoT Smart Products
category.description: Discover the future of connected living with our IoT Smart Products. We design and develop intelligent solutions that integrate seamlessly into everyday life, offering convenience, efficiency, and control. From home automation to industrial monitoring, our products ensure enhanced performance through real-time data and remote accessibility. Revolutionize your operations with smart devices built to meet the demands of modern lifestyles and business environments

products.title: Hydrogen (Smart-water-bottle)
products.description: Hydrogen is an AI-powered smart water bottle that features rapid heating and cooling, hydration tracking with advanced sensors, and personalized reminders for optimal water intake. Its ergonomic squircle design ensures style and comfort, while its innovative technology offers superior functionality. Perfect for on-the-go hydration, it redefines smart drinking solutions with intelligence, performance, and modern aesthetics

productDetails.title: Soft Touch button
productDetails.description: The soft touch button enables users to easily change modes, allowing for seamless transitions between heating, cooling, standby, and off settings. Its responsive design ensures quick activation and enhances user convenience, making it simple to adjust the bottle’s functions according to personal preferences.

productDetails.title: Responsive Led
productDetails.description: The responsive LED lights on the Hydrogen bottle visually indicate various statuses, such as temperature, hydration goals, or mode selection. These vibrant lights change colors based on user interactions, providing clear feedback on the current function and enhancing user engagement while promoting healthy hydration habits

productDetails.title: PCB Board
productDetails.description: The PCB board serves as the brain of the Hydrogen smart water bottle, integrating all electronic components and ensuring efficient communication between sensors, the app screen, and LED indicators. This compact board manages power distribution, data processing, and connectivity, facilitating seamless operation of the bottle's smart features.

productDetails.title: Air vent
productDetails.description: The Hydrogen smart water bottle features an air vent that allows hot air from the fan to escape, effectively releasing heat generated by the heatsink. This ventilation system ensures optimal temperature control, preventing overheating and maintaining the efficiency of the heating and cooling functions.

productDetails.title: App screen
productDetails.description: The integrated app screen offers a user-friendly interface for monitoring hydration levels, tracking water intake, and customizing settings. Through Bluetooth connectivity, users can sync their smart water bottle with their smartphones, providing real-time data and reminders to help maintain healthy hydration habits effortlessly.

products.title: RFID Child Tracking Device
products.description: A versatile child safety solution available as a card, module, or watch, this RFID tracking device ensures real-time location updates and customizable alerts. It’s adaptable for school, play, and travel, and extends its utility to applications like pet tracking, asset management, and workforce monitoring. This device offers parents peace of mind and provides efficient tracking for a wide range of needs

productDetails.title: Watch model
productDetails.description: The watch model is designed like a tag that can be securely tied to a child’s wrist. It offers a comfortable and non-intrusive way to track the child’s location, resembling a simple wristband while containing essential tracking technology for safety purposes

productDetails.title: RFID Reader
productDetails.description: The RFID Reader includes multiple antennas that emit radio waves to detect and communicate with nearby RFID tags. It captures signals from the tag and relays the information, allowing parents or guardians to monitor the child's location accurately through the tracking system.

productDetails.title: Tag Model
productDetails.description: The tag uses radio waves to transmit its identity and information to RFID readers. It can be passive or active, with passive tags relying on the reader for power and lacking a battery. This energy-efficient design ensures longer-term tracking without frequent maintenance.

products.title: Smart Furniture
products.description: Experience the future of home and office living with Smart Furniture. Featuring wireless charging, a built-in beverage heating and cooling system, intelligent lighting, and a retractable arm system for holding laptops or books with a nightlight. It also includes pop-up sockets and AI voice assistance for basic electronic controls like lights and AC. Smart Furniture combines functionality, comfort, and technology to redefine your personal and professional spaces

productDetails.title: Beverage warmer and cooler
productDetails.description: The smart table includes a Beverage Warmer and Cooler, which adjusts or maintains the temperature of a beverage placed on it according to the user’s input. It provides a convenient way to keep drinks warm or cool without manual intervention, enhancing the overall experience.

productDetails.title: Wireless Charger
productDetails.description: The table features an omnidirectional wireless charger, allowing electronic devices like phones, watches, and earbuds to charge efficiently. Devices with wireless charging capabilities can be placed in any direction on the surface, ensuring fast and convenient charging for multiple gadgets.

productDetails.title: 360 Sound Speaker
productDetails.description: The 360 Sound Speaker is a 3D surround system integrated into the table, delivering high-quality sound. It adapts to the music and atmosphere, creating an immersive audio experience. The speaker is designed to enhance ambiance and provide consistent sound from all directions

productDetails.title: Floating Light Effect
productDetails.description: The Floating Light Effect adds an elegant touch to the table, adjusting its intensity based on the music being played. It also functions as a night path light, offering soft illumination during the night, making it both a stylish and practical feature for any environment

productDetails.title: Retractable Table
productDetails.description: The Retractable Table is designed for convenience, transforming into a laptop or book table with a simple press. The adjustable arms allow for easy use while in bed, and it includes a light, making it ideal for reading or working in various comfortable positions.

products.title: S Connect (Smart Speaker)
products.description: S Connect is a next-gen smart speaker combining premium sound quality with intelligent voice control. It connects seamlessly to your smart devices, enabling hands-free operation and integration with IoT systems. Designed for versatility, it fits effortlessly into any setting, offering personalized assistance, dynamic entertainment, and superior connectivity. S Connect transforms your space into a hub of convenience and innovation.

productDetails.title: Surround Speaker
productDetails.description: The Connect S features a high-quality surround speaker system that delivers immersive 360-degree sound. Designed to fill the room with clear, crisp audio, the speaker adapts to various sound profiles, providing an exceptional listening experience for music, podcasts, and voice commands from any corner of the room.

productDetails.title: Display
productDetails.description: The smart speaker includes a built-in display that shows essential information like time, track details, weather updates, and notifications. This sleek, user-friendly screen offers a visual complement to the voice interaction, enhancing the overall functionality and convenience of the Connect S.

productDetails.title: Responsive light
productDetails.description: The Connect S is equipped with a responsive light feature that adjusts its brightness and color based on sound or voice activity. It enhances the ambiance of the room, reacting dynamically to music, commands, or notifications, making the interaction with the speaker visually engaging and stylish.

productDetails.title: Volume Nobe
productDetails.description: The Connect S features a tactile volume knob for easy and precise audio control. Designed for intuitive use, this smooth, responsive knob allows users to quickly adjust the volume level, offering a simple yet effective alternative to voice commands or app-based controls.
